issues.evidence: type() returns only {namespace, name}. SimpleTypeInfo.baseType, ListTypeInfo.elementType (Patient.address.type() -> empty), ClassInfo.element, TupleTypeInfoElement are unimplemented in both the Python engine and native C++ (verified dual-path parity: 0 diffs). Official R4 fixtures (tests-fhir-r4.xml testType group) only exercise .namespace/.name, so the STU metamodel shape is an intended gap. 'x'.type().baseType -> [] on both engines.
issues.root_cause: STU-era metamodel fields deliberately not implemented; official R4 fixtures only pin namespace/name
issues.resolution: Documented as intended gap in AGENTS.md; shape locked by test_environment_context_semantics_fp20.py

issues.spec_citation: FHIRPath §9 Environment Variables (%context = original node passed to the engine)
issues.evidence: fhir4ds/fhirpath/duckdb/context.py docstrings (lines 32, 240-241) claim %context 'changes with focus'. Actual behavior on core engine and both DuckDB paths keeps %context = original node (name.select(%context.id) -> ['p1','p1']), which is the spec-correct semantics. Docstrings misstate the contract.
issues.root_cause: Docstrings in context.py/evaluator.py predated the spec-correct %context=original-node behavior
issues.resolution: Corrected docstrings in fhir4ds/fhirpath/duckdb/context.py and evaluator.py

issues.spec_citation: FHIRPath §9 (undefined env var behavior is unspecified)
issues.evidence: Core evaluate() raises ValueError for %undefinedVar123; DuckDB UDFs (native and fallback, parity verified) return empty and fhirpath_is_valid=true (runtime concern, not syntax). Spec 2018Sep leaves undefined-variable behavior open; behavior is engine-consistent. Should be documented as intended.
issues.root_cause: FHIRPath 2018Sep leaves undefined-env-var behavior unspecified; UDF wrapper treats runtime env-var errors as empty, core raises
issues.resolution: Documented in AGENTS.md NOT A BUG registry; locked by test_undefined_environment_variable_is_runtime_not_syntax_fp20
